name: Torch Lighter
description: TSA rules for torch lighters and jet flame lighters on planes.

carryOn.reason: Torch lighters (jet lighters, blue-flame lighters) are prohibited in both carry-on and checked baggage by TSA regulations.

checkedBag.reason: Torch lighters are prohibited in checked baggage regardless of fuel content.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring a torch lighter on a plane?

travelTips: Torch lighters are always prohibited. Use a standard Bic or Zippo lighter instead — one is allowed in carry-on.

faq.question: Are torch lighters allowed on planes?
faq.answer: No. Torch lighters (jet lighters, blue-flame lighters) are prohibited in both carry-on and checked baggage by TSA.

faq.question: What is the difference between a regular lighter and a torch lighter on a plane?
faq.answer: A standard disposable lighter (Bic, Zippo) is allowed in carry-on. A torch lighter with a blue flame jet is completely prohibited in all baggage.
